So that's why I'm asking him whether he read this speech, as a conclusion of Arif Pasalic to the effect that war had started, so my next question will be directly linked to that.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: So I'd just like the witness to tell me whether we can understand the speech that way and if he understood it that way.

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Mr. Vegar, we had at least two witnesses here who lived in Mostar at the time and who said that regardless of the conflicts that took place in May and June 1993, that the real conflict, serious conflict, occurred only after the events of the 30th of June, 1993. Would you agree with that assessment?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. From that day on, the conflict intensified.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Now, take a look at the last passage, the last paragraph in that speech. In that last paragraph, Mr. Arif Pasalic calls upon all citizens able to bear arms and every citizen who can carry a rock to kill Ustasha criminals. Tell us, Mr. Vegar, can this be considered a call to each and every citizen to use rifles, rocks, or in any other way to stand up to the HVO?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, precisely.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: That's all I wanted to ask you in relation to this document. Now, in the separate set of documents, in connection with Judge Antonetti's question as to how a report by Tihomir Blaskic was not sent to the head of the Defence Department, Mr. Stojic, we prepared six reports at random. You can leaf through them. They're not essential to us. We're not dealing with the contents of those, but just to see direct communication between Mr. Tihomir Blaskic and the head of the Defence Department, Bruno Stojic. And in that connection comes my next question. Were you informed and aware, Mr. Vegar, that certain commanders of the brigades and commanders of operative zones would send certain reports directly to Mr. Stojic as well?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: The third topic, as we said, relates to the April announcement. Now, Mr. Vegar, I'm going to go briefly through your functions, and I hope I understood what you said correctly. From September to the 31st of January, 1993, the head of IPD -- you were head of IPD; right?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, the Information and Propaganda Department, Moral Guidance Sector.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Now, from the 1st of February, 1993, you were de facto assistant head of the Defence Department for Morale and officially appointed to the function on the 27th of August, 1993; is that right?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: And you were also the spokesman for the Defence Department, were you not?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: And as a deputy for your colleague from the HZ-HB, sometimes you would be a spokesman for the government as well?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, I wasn't a spokesman for the Croatian Defence Council at the HZ-HB. That was just an exceptional situation on one occasion, when my colleague from that department was not there, so I had to step in and draw up an announcement.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: All right. So I will correct myself. You weren't a spokesman, but you wrote reports for meetings. Can I also conclude that you were never a spokesman of the Main Staff of the HVO?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you can conclude that.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Very well, thank you. Now, in my journalist documents, I looked through articles to see how you were presented and represented in the media, and I see you were represented as being the spokesman of the Main Staff, and as the spokesman for the HVO, and even as the head of the Defence Department. Can you confirm, Mr. Vegar, that different newspapers and media defined your post and function differently?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's a typical example of imprecision on the part of a journalist or journalists.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: I'm going to skip over two documents that my colleague Senka Nozica showed you, which is the minutes from a session of the Croatian Defence Council in April 1993. The document is P 1798, and an article appearing in "Slobodna Dalmacija," signed with your name. It is a statement from that session. P 9519 is the document number, and I'm sure you will remember those documents. I don't think we need waste time reading them.

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Let's see what the foreign media wrote. And in my set of documents, look at P 10675, for instance. We have the first piece of information, which is Reuters, and in the third paragraph or section, it says -- or, rather, it talks about the ultimatum. In the statement it says, "The Command of the Bosnian Croat forces." And then a little further down on page 5 for you, we have the article from the "Christian Science Monitor" where the eruption of the crisis is mentioned, and an ultimatum of the 15th of April is mentioned there too. And finally we have "Agence France Presse" which in similar fashion defines that press release. And now look at another document and I'm going to ask you a question. My colleagues tell me that on e-court, the wrong document was pulled up, but I see that there is nothing on e-court now, whereas the number of the document was properly recorded on the transcript, P 0675. Now look at P 1808, P 1808. That's a short article from Belgrade daily "Borba" of the 5th of April, 1993, and it carries information from Reuters, and there, too, it says that the HVO Command issued a statement, asked for something, and so on. So, Mr. Vegar, can we conclude that the information which relates to your announcement and the HVO HZ-HB session of the 3rd of April were wrongly portrayed in the media as being a statement from the Main Staff of the HVO?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we can say that, and I think that in these reports the news agencies, as far as the statement goes -- well, I just conveyed this message to the media without any comments on my part.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Now I'd like to draw Their Honours' attention to part of the cross-examination by my learned friend Mr. Scott, Defence witness Prlic -- or, rather, Neven Tomic, and the pages I'm referring to are the following: 34713, 34713, 34713.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] One moment before you continue, Ms. Alaburic. Witness, Ms. Alaburic thought it useful to mention this document from "Borba." Since she did so, let me ask you a question. It is stated here that Izetbegovic did not want to sign the agreement of the 15th of April and that the HVO will unilaterally establish its authority in Provinces 7, 8 and 10, and that comes from an HVO headquarter in Mostar. Was it normal for the headquarters to take such a stance, whilst this was an international agreement? How do you account for this press release from the HVO HQ?

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Just a moment. Your Honour Judge Antonetti, what I -- my questions so far have the purpose of showing you that it was not a press release from the Main Staff of the HVO, so I would appreciate it, if you go on questioning on the subject, please bear in mind that it's not a press release of the Main Staff, but of the HVO HZ-HB. And my questioning has the purpose of finally clearing up in this courtroom --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] All the more reason to ask an answer from the witness. Your "Borba" colleagues, when they quoted a press release from the HVO headquarters, did they get it wrong or not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, they made a mistake. They quoted the wrong press release. In fact, there was no press release from the Main Staff in that period at all, and the source for this piece of information or disinformation can only be among press releases from the sessions of the HVO HZ-HB, because there is simply no press release of the Main Staff.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Just two questions, perhaps, on this. I quoted transcript 34713 and 34714, and both Judge Antonetti and my learned friend Mr. Scott questioned the witness about where he was working, and the witness could not say that he was working for the HVO HZ-HB, but he did work for the military component.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: And at the end of this subject, the witness said you were the board parole [as interpreted], the spokesperson of the military department of the HVO?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the witness answer again, because he spoke at the same time as counsel.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Could you please repeat your answer? My question was: Can we agree again that you were not the spokesperson for the Main Staff? And your answer is?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: I was the spokesperson for the Defence Department.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Now we come to a very important question. In all these foreign media, mention is made of an ultimatum and the date 15th April. In the transcripts of the HVO HZ-HB sessions, and your press release, there is no reference to an ultimatum or a date by which the Muslim side should accept the implementation of the Vance-Owen Plan. Tell me, does your press release faithfully reflect what actually happened at the HVO session?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, precisely.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: I have finished with this area. Now, Mr. Vegar, could we discuss the vertical and horizontal organisation of the Sector for Moral Guidance. I will share with you one impression, and you will correct me if I'm wrong. I had the feeling that when you were talking about people working in that sector, you were talking about the entire vertical organisation, and that when you say people in the IPD, you also include assistant commanders, and that's why counsel for Mr. Stojic asked you several times if you make a distinction between various workers in the sector as opposed to IPD officers in military units. Was that a problem in communication, really?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could all extra microphones please be switched off.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Could we now look at some basic documents to see if officers in this Sector for Moral Guidance include assistant commanders in military units. I know, Mr. Vegar, that you are not a lawyer, and I don't expect you to interpret law, but I believe you can be of help to us in understanding the real military organisation. One of my colleagues warns me that the witness's answer to my question from line 8 is not recorded, whether it was really a problem in communication. Your answer, Mr. Vegar?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Answer with a "yes."

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: The first document I'd like you to see --

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: I was trying not to, Your Honours, I was trying to sort it out for myself and the transcript, but I can't find where the witness says what was his press release. There was a reference in the question, whether his press release accurately reflected the minutes of the HVO HZ-HB meeting, and I apologise in particular to Ms. Alaburic if I missed it, but we looked at the one press article from "Borba," and the witness information there that I saw there, the testimony is that the journalists had gotten it wrong, it was misinterpreted. So I don't know, when the question is put, "Was your press release," the press release of this witness, "... based on and accurately reflected what happened at the HVO HZ-HB meeting," what press release we're talking about, and if I missed it, I apologise. If someone could assist me, it would be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Gladly, Your Honour. I thought it was not necessary to dwell on this excessively, but I would like Mr. Scott to look up P 9519 in my set of documents. It's a press release published in "Slobodna Dalmacija" under the name "Veso Vegar." It's an official document admitted into evidence already. And in response to a question from Ms. Nozica, the witness did say it was, indeed, the press release from that session of the government. The witness also explained he did not attend the session. He prepared the press release based on the transcript, and that that transcript is P 1798. And from that article in "Slobodna Dalmacija," we can see that, indeed, the witness very faithfully conveyed the debate and the conclusions of the session of the HVO HZ-HB.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Can you tell me, Mr. Vegar, what I just explained for the benefit of Mr. Scott, is that really true? Did I interpret your evidence correctly?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: You did, you did.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: So to come back to the horizontal and vertical organisation of the Sector for Moral Guidance, it is an important subject to us, because it matters a lot to establish whether, in the vertical organisation of this sector, there is the Main Staff or the Defence Department, that is, the head of the Defence Department. That's why we are dealing with this. The first document is P 586. You have already seen that document. It's a decision on the basics of the organisation of the Defence Department. You told the Stojic Defence about paragraph 6 of the document, dealing with moral guidance. Some correcting. P 586. Please look at paragraph 14 of that document. In that paragraph 6, it says that the way of management of internal units and other relationships within the department shall be decided upon by the head of the Defence Department, with the consent of the president of the Croatian Community of Herceg-Bosna. Is that what it says here?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we can understand it that way.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: This provision seems to say that the Main Staff of the HVO will not participate in defining the model of the Sector for Moral Guidance; correct?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Another document is 2D 567. In para D of this document, reference is made to the Sector for Moral Guidance. This segment has three paragraphs. In the first one, we read about the way heads of certain administrations are appointed. In the second paragraph, it's about appointment and relief of assistant commanders of operations zones and military units. And now in this third paragraph that begins with the words: "All the other officers and operatives of the Main Staff shall be appointed by the chief of the Main Staff [as interpreted]," when we look at this language, "other," it seems to mean that the staff mentioned in the first two paragraphs is also personnel of the Main Staff. Can you agree with this?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Now, you told us, Mr. Vegar, at some point, and I believe it should be cleared up --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: I'm sorry. I draw your attention to the fact that there is either a problem of translation or you may have misspoken, because you have quoted page 103: "All the other officers and operatives of the Main Staff ..." I've heard that, but you wanted to say "of the Moral Sector," I suppose.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, thank you. I can't always follow the record. I was not talking about the Main Staff at all. I quoted one section of this decision, and the witness and I understood each other, because there was no misunderstanding in our language. So in the third paragraph, it says that: "All the other employees and operatives in the Sector for Moral Guidance shall be assigned by the chief -- by the assistant head of the Defence Department."

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's why my question was the Main Staff does not participate in selecting the model of the Sector for Moral Guidance, and the witness answered affirmatively.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: You told us yesterday -- Mr. Vegar, you told us that assistant commanders for IPD were subordinated primarily to the commander of the military unit or the operations zone they were in. I'm interested in the word "primarily," and I want you to tell us to whom else they were subordinated, apart from their own commander.

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Apart from their own commander, they were in communication with employees of the IPD, IPD personnel at levels superior to their own, up to the assistant chief of the Defence Department Sector for Moral Guidance.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: All right. Now look at -- skip two documents and look at 4D 1284. It's a diagram of the Sector for Moral Guidance prepared by my associates. Look at the sector structured in this way, and you can see on the basis of which documents this diagram was developed. Is it approximately the way it was envisaged by the regulatory acts -- enactments, documents on the organisation of the Defence Department? Is it consistent with your knowledge?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: Speaking of the professional vertical line, does it go exactly like it is drawn here: Assistant commander of the company through the assistant commander of the battalion, and then assistant commander of the brigade, then assistant commander of the operations zone, up to the assistant chief of the Defence Department, later minister?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: The Stojic Defence showed you several orders of General Petkovic relating to his activity, which was closely linked to information and the work of your sector, but these orders were from the year 1992, so I won't deal with them, because at that time sectors were only being developed and established and relations were only arising, but I'd like you to comment on P 2331. That's a request dated 12 May 1993, addressed by General Petkovic to Chief Bruno Stojic, and I'd like to remind both the Trial Chamber and my colleagues from the Prosecution that the document was mistranslated as "Order." The translation should have been "Request." Now, tell us, Mr. Vegar, if you can, when somebody who belongs to the military, in what cases do they write an order and in what cases do they write requests, if you know?

utterances.speaker: VESO VEGAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: I suppose requests are written to someone to whom you cannot issue orders, and if somebody is lower in the hierarchy than you are, then you can write an order.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: There's also a situation --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You have to finish at quarter to, because the Popovic trial is on this afternoon and I don't want to go over time and take some of their time. We have to finish for the day. You have exactly -- well, we'll tell you how much time you have exactly, and we shall continue with the cross-examination tomorrow. I wish you all a good afternoon. We shall reconvene tomorrow at 9.00 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 18th day of February, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.
